scope: Actual frozen BaseItem.RefreshMetadata/RefreshExtras, LibraryManager.FindExtras/ExtraResolver for ordinary files and Series/Season/MusicArtist/MusicAlbum directory owners, ordinary video/audio resolution, and DeleteItem with ItemPersistenceService/EF SQLite over actual files. Records discovery, name locks/correction, stable/full dispatch, owned assignment, missing extra deletion, cancellation, selected columns, complete stored Data, provider dispatch, cache and events. The single-item provider performs no save: newly discovered extras remain live entities with no DB row or Added event. Collection membership, savers, media-source list and external-file dispatch are controls. No candidate implementation, complete scanner, network/provider saves, generic deletion or release acceptance.
candidateComparison: All 17 actual native samples fully compared on real SQLite/PostgreSQL, including Series/Season/MusicArtist/MusicAlbum directory owners, with selected columns, complete Data, exact file hashes, dispatch, events, failures and cancellation. Media uses Memory VFS and controlled creation time; instance file deletion is real. Cached path spellings are retained. Read-only D3 previews are separate from the native mutation trace. Repository fixture reproduces its synchronous controlled provider scheduling without serializing production owned tasks. Additional host tests cover ordinary file/directory first saves, live owner, competing rows/owners, transactional owner baselines, D3, weak listings and Audio deletion. Scoped evidence does not prove complete MetadataService/scalar mapper, .ignore/disc/network, generic deletion, full scanning or release acceptance.
